data.name: KeyTagsWindowGuard
data.value: Stop when another window comes to the front

data.name: KeyTagsWindowGuardToolTip
data.value: Protects against keys landing in the wrong program. Per snippet: {guard,off} turns it off, e.g. to automate the Start menu. Holding Esc always stops a snippet.

data.name: FormWindowChangedFormat
data.value:
"{0}" was stopped because another window came to the front.
If the snippet switches windows on purpose, start it with {{guard,off}}.

data.name: FormElementNotFoundFormat
data.value:
"{0}" was stopped: {1} found nothing in the front window within {2} seconds.
The element picker (crosshair in the popup or tray menu) shows how the element can be found.

data.name: FormWindowNotFoundFormat
data.value: "{0}" was stopped: no window for {1} came up within {2} seconds. Is the program open?

data.name: FormWindowNotActivatedFormat
data.value: "{0}" was stopped: the window for {1} couldn't be brought to the front.

data.name: FormStartFailedFormat
data.value: "{0}" was stopped: {1} couldn't start the program. {2}

data.name: FormNoDefaultBrowser
data.value: Windows has no default browser for web addresses. Choose one under Settings › Apps › Default apps.

data.name: FormStartedWindowNotFoundFormat
data.value:
"{0}" was stopped: {1} started the program, but no window of it came up within {2} seconds.
The window is recognized by the program's name. If the program opens its window under another name (a launcher or a Store app, e.g. calc), start it by hand and use {{window,title=…}} instead.

data.name: FormScriptFailedFormat
data.value: "{0}" was stopped: the script in block {1} failed. {2}

data.name: FormConditionFailedFormat
data.value: "{0}" was stopped: the condition in {1} failed. {2}

data.name: FormConditionNoScriptsFormat
data.value: "{0}" was stopped: {1} needs scripts, but they are turned off in the settings.

data.name: TargetElevatedFormat
data.value:
"{0}" can't reach {1}: it runs as administrator, and Windows doesn't let normal programs send keys to it.
Start {1} without administrator rights (in its shortcut: Properties › Advanced/Compatibility › turn off "Run as administrator"). QuickHasteBot itself doesn't need them.

data.name: PickerElevatedFormat
data.value: {0} runs as administrator: Windows doesn't let QuickHasteBot see or fill its fields. Start it without administrator rights.

data.name: PickerIncludeWindowToolTip
data.value: Puts {window,…} in front, so the snippet first brings this program to the front, wherever you start it from.

data.name: PickerActionFocusToolTip
data.value: {focus,…}: puts the cursor into the field. Text after the tag is typed there, e.g. {focus,#email}max@example.com

data.name: PickerActionClickToolTip
data.value: {click,…}: clicks a button, link, tab or checkbox, like a mouse click.

data.name: PickerActionDoubleClickToolTip
data.value: {dblclick,…}: double-clicks the element with the mouse, e.g. to open a list entry or file.

data.name: PickerActionRightClickToolTip
data.value: {rclick,…}: right-clicks the element with the mouse. A {click,name=…} afterwards picks an entry from its context menu.

data.name: PickerActionSetToolTip
data.value: {set,…,"value"}: fills a field directly, picks a dropdown option by its text or sets a checkbox to on/off. Edit the value in the tag below.

data.name: PickerTestToolTip
data.value: Runs the tag now in the program the element was picked in, like a snippet would. A click really clicks.

data.name: PickerTestDone
data.value: Test passed: the element was found and the tag ran.

data.name: PickerTestNoTag
data.value: That isn't a valid tag, e.g. {focus,#email}.

data.name: EditorFolderToolTip
data.value: Choose another folder. The snippet moves there when you save.

data.name: EditorInsertTagToolTip
data.value: Keys, pauses, form elements, windows and script helpers, inserted at the cursor

data.name: EditorPickerToolTip
data.value: Opens the crosshair picker; "Insert into editor" puts the tag at the cursor here

data.name: EditorPreviewMessageNote
data.value: msg() and confirm() show nothing here, confirm() gives true. They only show with Test (F5).

data.name: EditorPreviewRunNote
data.value: run() starts nothing here and returns an empty result. It only runs with Test (F5).

data.name: EditorTestToolTip
data.value: Then click into the target field: the snippet runs there as if pasted, with the text as it is now. With a selection only the selection runs, with the cursor in a tag or script only that one (F5)

data.name: EditorTestClickTarget
data.value: Now click into the target field

data.name: EditorChangedOnDiskFormat
data.value: "{0}" was changed in another program in the meantime. Overwrite it anyway?

data.name: TagWindow
data.value: bring a program to the front

data.name: TagStart
data.value: start, else bring to the front

data.name: TagLetterKey
data.value: letter as a real key press

data.name: TagStartUrl
data.value: web address in the default browser

data.name: TagMessageOptions
data.value: message box with title, icon, closing by itself

data.name: TagKeyHelp
data.value: Presses {0}. Keys combine with +, e.g. {{ctrl+s}}; a number after a comma presses it several times, e.g. {{pgdn,2}}.

data.name: TagKeyHelperHelp
data.value: key('tab') presses a key instead of typing text, with the names of the key tags: key('shift+tab'), key('down', 3). The result has to end up in the output, e.g. {{ ['Max', 'Muster'].join(key('tab')) }}.

data.name: TagNextFieldHelp
data.value: Presses Tab: on to the next field, like you would by hand. Counting tabs breaks when the form changes; {focus,…} and {set,…} address a field directly.

data.name: TagPreviousFieldHelp
data.value: Presses Shift+Tab: back to the previous field.

data.name: TagSubmitHelp
data.value: Presses Enter: submits the form or confirms a dialog. A line break in the text is sent as Shift+Enter and doesn't submit; only {enter} does.

data.name: TagCheckboxHelp
data.value: Presses Space: ticks or unticks the checkbox that has the focus. {set,#id,"on"} sets it regardless of its state.

data.name: TagCancelHelp
data.value: Presses Esc: cancels, closes a dialog or an open list. Your own Esc, held down, stops a running snippet.

data.name: TagUpHelp
data.value: Arrow up, e.g. one entry up in a list. {up,3} presses it three times.

data.name: TagDownHelp
data.value: Arrow down, e.g. one entry down in a list or dropdown.

data.name: TagRepeatHelp
data.value: A number after the comma repeats a key: {down,3} is three times arrow down. Works with every key tag, e.g. {tab,2}.

data.name: TagLeftHelp
data.value: Arrow left: one character back in a field, or the previous tab or option.

data.name: TagRightHelp
data.value: Arrow right: one character on in a field, or the next tab or option.

data.name: TagHomeHelp
data.value: Home: to the start of the line. {ctrl+home} goes to the start of the text.

data.name: TagEndHelp
data.value: End: to the end of the line. {ctrl+end} goes to the end of the text, e.g. to add to it.

data.name: TagBackspaceHelp
data.value: Backspace: deletes the character left of the cursor. {bs,5} deletes five.

data.name: TagDeleteHelp
data.value: Delete: deletes the character right of the cursor, or what is selected.

data.name: TagSelectAllHelp
data.value: Ctrl+A: selects everything in the field. To empty a field before typing, {clear} is shorter.

data.name: TagOpenDropdownHelp
data.value: Alt+Down: opens the dropdown that has the focus. To pick an option, {set,#id,"option"} is more reliable.

data.name: TagSendChatHelp
data.value: Ctrl+Enter: sends in Outlook, Teams and many web editors, where Enter only starts a new line.

data.name: TagReloadHelp
data.value: F5: reloads a web page or refreshes a view. Every function key from {f1} to {f24} works the same way.

data.name: TagNumPlusHelp
data.value: Numpad +: expands the selected folder or node in a tree, e.g. the folder list in Outlook or Explorer. A typed + does not do that. The other numpad keys: {num0} to {num9}, {numdiv}, {numdot}, {numenter}.

data.name: TagNumMinusHelp
data.value: Numpad −: collapses the selected folder or node in a tree.

data.name: TagNumMulHelp
data.value: Numpad *: expands the selected node with all its subfolders. In big trees this takes a moment, {wait,500} afterwards helps.

data.name: TagZoomInHelp
data.value: Ctrl and the + key: zooms in in browsers and many programs, {ctrl+minus} zooms out, {ctrl+0} resets. {plus}, {minus}, {comma} and {period} combine with every modifier. If a program ignores it, try {ctrl+numplus}.

data.name: TagLetterKeyHelp
data.value: {key,a} presses the A key instead of typing the letter: for Remote Desktop, Citrix and shortcuts without Ctrl, e.g. j/k in webmail. A capital letter adds Shift ({key,A}), a number repeats it ({key,a,3}). Letters and digits only.

data.name: TagPrintScreenHelp
data.value: Print Screen: copies the screen or opens the Snipping Tool, depending on the Windows settings; {alt+prtsc} takes only the active window. Also there: {pause}, {capslock}, {numlock}, {scrolllock}.

data.name: TagPlayPauseHelp
data.value: Media key play/pause, goes to the player that is playing. Also: {nexttrack}, {prevtrack}, {mediastop}, {volumeup}, {volumedown}, {volumemute}.

data.name: TagBrowserBackHelp
data.value: The browser key Back, like Alt+Left in the browser. Also: {browserforward}, {browserrefresh}, {browserhome}.

data.name: TagCommentHelp
data.value: A note to yourself; it is never pasted. It may span several lines and ends at the first }. On a line of its own, the whole line goes.

data.name: TagWaitHelp
data.value: Waits 500 ms before going on, e.g. until a dropdown opens or a dialog appears. At most 10 s. Not needed for fields: {focus}, {click} and {set} wait up to 5 s for their element.

data.name: TagDelayHelp
data.value: From here on, pauses 50 ms after every key and character. For slow forms and programs that lose characters; Notepad in Windows 11 needs {delay,30}.

data.name: TagClearHelp
data.value: Ctrl+A and Delete: empties a prefilled field before typing, e.g. {focus,#city}{clear}Bern.

data.name: TagGuardOffHelp
data.value: Turns the window guard off: the snippet goes on even if another window comes to the front. Needed when the snippet switches windows itself, e.g. with {win}.

data.name: TagGuardOnHelp
data.value: Turns the window guard back on, for the window that is in front at that moment. The snippet stops if another window comes to the front.

data.name: TagFocusHelp
data.value: Puts the cursor into a field, and the text after it is typed there. #id finds the id, name=Label the label (* for any text: name=Inbox*), .class the class, help=Tooltip the tooltip. Put the area first with " > ": name=Delivery address > name=Street. The element picker finds the right one for you.

data.name: TagClickHelp
data.value: Clicks a button, link, tab or checkbox by its label (name=Send) or id (#send). * stands for any text: name=Inbox* also finds "Inbox - 2 unread items". Add ;type=button if several elements have the same label.

data.name: TagDoubleClickHelp
data.value: Double-clicks an element with the mouse, e.g. a list entry, a file or a table row, by its label (name=Report) or id (#report). Always a real mouse click, so the element must be visible on the screen.

data.name: TagRightClickHelp
data.value: Right-clicks an element with the mouse, by its label (name=Report) or id (#report). The context menu that opens is part of the window: {click,name=Copy} picks an entry from it.

data.name: TagSetHelp
data.value: Fills a field directly, picks a dropdown option by its text or sets a checkbox to "on"/"off": {set,#country,"Austria"}. Some web forms only notice typed text; then use {focus,…} and the text.

data.name: TagWindowHelp
data.value: Brings a program to the front, and the rest of the snippet goes there: {window,crm} matches the program crm.exe or a title containing "crm". Waits up to 5 s if the window isn't there yet.

data.name: TagStartHelp
data.value: Like {window,…}, but starts the program if it isn't running, and waits up to 30 s for its window. A name Windows knows (notepad, excel, chrome) or a full path; a second argument in quotes is passed to the program.

data.name: TagStartUrlHelp
data.value: Opens the address in the default browser, in a new tab if it's already running, and waits for the page's window. Then fill in the page with {set,…} and {click,…}.

data.name: TagDateHelp
data.value: Today's date as a short date (03.11.2026). With a format, e.g. date('dddd, dd. MMMM yyyy'), as you like it.

data.name: TagDateInHelp
data.value: The date in 14 days. Negative numbers go back: date('dd.MM.yyyy', -1) is yesterday.

data.name: TagTimeHelp
data.value: The current time as HH:mm (14:05). time('HH:mm:ss') adds the seconds.

data.name: TagWeekHelp
data.value: The ISO calendar week (45). isoweek(7) is the week in 7 days.

data.name: TagClipboardHelp
data.value: The text that was on the clipboard before pasting, e.g. {{ clipboard.trim() }}. Tags in it are never pressed.

data.name: TagUserHelp
data.value: The Windows user name of whoever pastes the snippet.

data.name: TagGuidHelp
data.value: A new unique ID every time, e.g. for reference numbers.

data.name: TagRunHelp
data.value: Runs a script or program at this point and waits until it is done (60 s by default). r.out is what it printed, r.code its exit code; {{ r.out.trim() }} types the output.

data.name: TagRunOptionsHelp
data.value: Like run(), with options: args is passed to the script, dir is its working folder ("Start in"; otherwise the script's folder), wait the seconds to wait, hidden: true starts it without a window.

data.name: TagPowerShellHelp
data.value: Runs a PowerShell command and types what it prints, here the computer name; .trim() removes the line break at the end. Single quotes inside the command are written as \' in JavaScript. A .ps1 file runs directly: run('d:/scripts/file.ps1').

data.name: TagMessageHelp
data.value: Shows a message box and waits for OK, e.g. at the end of a form: "Done". Nothing is typed. Esc stops the snippet. Options: { title: 'Order', icon: 'warning', close: 5, after: 300 }. alert() doesn't exist in scripts, msg() takes its place.

data.name: TagMessageOptionsHelp
data.value: title sets the title bar (default QuickHasteBot). icon is 'info' (default), 'warning', 'error' or 'none', with the sound of Windows. close: 5 closes the message after 5 seconds by itself, so the snippet goes on without a click; the OK button counts down. after: 300 shows the message only after 300 seconds, in the background, and the snippet doesn't wait for it (e.g. a timer).

data.name: TagConfirmHelp
data.value: Asks Yes or No when the snippet gets there: Yes runs what follows {if}, No what follows {else}. Esc stops the snippet. confirm() works in scripts too: {{ confirm('Urgent?') ? 'URGENT: ' : '' }}. With { title: '…', icon: 'warning' } like msg().

data.value: Edit snippets in the built-in editor

data.name: UseBuiltInEditorToolTip
data.value: With tag palette, element picker, preview and test run. Off: "Edit" opens the program Windows uses for the file type. Either way, the right-click menu offers both.

data.name: TrayAiPrompt
data.value: Write a script block with AI…

data.name: PickerHint
data.value: Hold the mouse button on the crosshair, drag it onto a field, button or link and let go. The tag for it is then copied, e.g. {focus,#email}.

data.name: PickerDragging

data.name: PickerChecking

data.name: PickerCopied

data.name: PickerUnverified

data.name: PickerNothing

data.name: WriteLogToolTip
data.value: Writes QuickHasteBot.log next to the exe: errors, startup, and every program and script a snippet starts. Helps when something goes wrong.

data.name: RememberFolderTooltip
data.value: Start in this folder next time

data.name: KeepOpenTooltip
data.value: Keep open when another window gets the focus, to paste several snippets one after another (Ctrl+T). Stays on until you switch it off.

data.name: RememberQueryTooltip
data.value: Keep this search text next time, Enter starts the same entry again

data.name: EditorStepRunToolTip
data.value: Then click into the target field: the whole snippet runs there and pauses before each step. F10 runs the next step, F5 runs to the next breakpoint. Click the left margin to set a breakpoint (F9).

data.name: EditorStartsWithWindowFormat
data.value: Starts with {0}, no click into the target field needed.

data.name: EditorStepRunning

data.name: StepBarFieldNotFound
data.value: The field isn't there yet. The step waits for it for a few seconds.

data.name: EditorRecordToolTip
data.value: Then click into the target window and fill in the form once yourself: fields, choices, checkboxes and clicks become tags at the cursor. Single keys like Tab or Enter are not recorded, only what they do.

data.name: EditorRecordClickTarget
data.value: Now click into the target window

data.name: EditorRecordWaiting

data.name: EditorRecording
data.value: Recording: fill in the form, then Done in the bar. The text is locked meanwhile.

data.name: EditorRecordedNothing
data.value: Nothing recorded: no field changed and nothing clicked.

data.name: RecordBarModeMixedToolTip
data.value: Type into text fields like a person, set dropdowns and checkboxes to the value

data.name: RecordBarModeSetToolTip
data.value: Set every field to the value directly: shortest, but some web forms don't notice it

data.name: RecordBarModeTypeToolTip
data.value: Focus and type into every field, click checkboxes

data.name: RecordBarHint
data.value: Keys like Tab or Enter are not recorded, only what they do.

data.name: RecordBarPassword
data.value: Password field: only focused, the password itself is not recorded.

data.name: RecordBarElevated
data.value: This program runs as administrator, Windows doesn't let anything be recorded there.

data.name: RecordBarUnnamed
data.value: An element without id, label or class can't be found again and is left out of the recording.

data.name: IncludeNotFoundFormat
data.value: {{include,{0}}} names no text snippet. Write the folder and name as in the popup, e.g. {{include,Sign-offs/Kind regards}}.

data.name: IncludeTooDeepFormat

data.name: AskPromptFormat
data.value: "{0}" needs a few details before it is pasted:

data.name: EditorPreviewAskNote

data.name: EditorNoFormattedText
data.value: No formatted text on the clipboard. Copy it first, e.g. a signature in Outlook or Word.

data.name: TagCursorHelp
data.value: After pasting, the cursor stands here instead of at the end, e.g. Dear {cursor},. Only text may follow it, no keys.

data.name: TagIncludeHelp
data.value: Inserts the text of another snippet here, with its tags and scripts, e.g. a signature kept in one place. Folder and name as in the popup, the number in front can be left out.

data.name: TagHtmlHelp
data.value: Everything between {html} and {/html} is pasted as formatted text: bold, links, lists, tables, in Outlook, Word, Teams and web mail. Tags in it are text; scripts run.

data.name: TagHtmlPasteHelp
data.value: Copy formatted text, e.g. a signature in Outlook, and insert it here as an {html} block. Ctrl+Shift+V does the same.

data.name: TagIf
data.value: if an element is there, else …

data.name: TagIfHelp
data.value: Checks while running whether the element is there and visible, waiting up to 1 second (longer with wait=3000). If so, what follows {if} runs, otherwise what follows {else}. More cases with {elseif,…}, the opposite with not: {if,not,name=OK}. Blocks may be nested, every {if} needs its {/if}.

data.name: TagIfWindow
data.value: if a program is open, else …

data.name: TagIfWindowHelp
data.value: Checks whether a window of the program is open, or with title=… one with that title. If so, it comes to the front like with {window} and what follows {if} runs, otherwise what follows {else}.

data.name: TagIfScript
data.value: if a script expression is true, else …

data.name: TagIfScriptHelp
data.value: Checks a JavaScript expression when the snippet gets there, with the variables of the blocks before it, e.g. the answer of ask() or the result of run(). Write text inside the quotes with ': js="answer == 'yes'".

data.name: TagSelectionHelp
data.value: The text that was selected in the target window before pasting, '' if nothing was. QuickHasteBot copies it with Ctrl+C and puts the clipboard back afterwards.

data.name: TagAskHelp
data.value: Asks before pasting and puts in what was typed, e.g. {{ ask('Customer', 'Muster') }} with a default. All ask() of a snippet come in one window; the same label is asked once.

data.name: UpdateNotificationText
data.value: A new version of QuickHasteBot is available.

data.name: CheckForUpdatesToolTip
data.value: Asks GitHub once a day for the newest version, without sending anything about you.
